summary: Introduction to the ansible-core 2.18 porting guide describing changes from ansible-core 2.17, to be read with the 2.18 changelog.
questions: Where do I start when upgrading to ansible-core 2.18?

answer_card.title: ansible-core 2.17 → 2.18 overview
answer_card.answer_md: The ansible-core **2.18** porting guide lists behaviour changes since **2.17** that may require updates to playbooks, plugins and other content. Read it together with the ansible-core 2.18 changelog.
